svg.title: The eleven steps of a sale, and the five we focused on
svg.desc: Eleven steps stand round a platform, from the first lead to after the trip. The first five, from first contact to the proposal, are raised: this is where we focused. Step five produces the proposal the client receives, a real one, lying beside the platform.
